artworks.title: Suspension d'audience (Recess of the Hearing)
artworks.medium: lithograph on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a woman sitting on a bench, holding a small child on her lap. She has a downcast gaze, short dark hair, and is wearing a long dress. Several indistinct figures are around her, and the background is heavily shaded.

artworks.title: L'avocat invectivé (The Lawyer Abused)
artworks.medium: lithograph on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a person leaning over a barrier, captured from mid-body upward. This individual is bent forward slightly, with their head tilted downward. Their hair is dark and appears tousled, and their facial features are expressive, though the exact expression is difficult to discern due to the sketch's shadowy lines. The person is dressed in dark clothing covering most of their body, and there is another individual nearby wearing what seems to be a uniform with a helmet. This second individual appears to be holding the first person by the shoulders. The environment around them is heavily shaded, suggesting an indoor setting. Vertical lines in the background may represent wall paneling or a wooden surface. The background is a sketchy, indistinct area filled with lines and forms, creating a sense of darkness and depth.

artworks.title: Scène de cabinet particulier (planche en largeur) (Scene in a Private Room) (horizontal plate)
artworks.medium: transfer lithograph on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a seated man with a visible upper body and a woman standing beside him. The man has a large mustache and dark, parted hair, with one hand resting on the table. The woman has one hand on her head and is wearing a long, dark dress. The man is wearing a shirt with a tie and a jacket. They are at a table with a cloth covering it, and a bottle is present. The background includes a textured wall and drapery or curtains.

artworks.title: Le Christ dépouillé de se vêtements (Christ Stripped of His Clothes)
artworks.medium: transfer lithograph on laid Van Gelder paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of several figures in an emotional moment. The drawing is executed in a loose, sketch-like manner with bold lines. Two figures are interacting in the center, one supporting the other. Another figure kneels and gestures upwards. Faint lines in the background suggest more figures or landscape features.

artworks.title: Ambroise Vollard, quatre esquisses (Ambroise Vollard, four sketches)
artworks.medium: lithograph on wove paper
artworks.description: The image contains four sketches of a man's head in different poses. Each sketch features the head and partial neck area from various angles. The top left sketch is a side profile showing the man's bald head and mustache. The top right sketch is a front-facing view with a beard and prominent brow. The bottom left sketch shows the head slightly inclined downward with closed eyes. The bottom right sketch, akin to the top left, features a side profile highlighting the beard and mustache. The sketches are rendered in graphite on a light beige background, maintaining a minimalist style without detailed clothing or surroundings.

artworks.title: Avocat parlant à sa cliente (Lawyer Talking to His Client)
artworks.medium: lithograph on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a courtroom scene. It shows various individuals in a courtroom setting. A figure in a military uniform is on the left, overseeing proceedings. Adjacent to them, two individuals are in conversation, one wearing a wide-brimmed hat. In the center, a group of men seems to be discussing, with one figure appearing to listen intently. The background includes a seated audience, depicted with simple strokes and shading suggesting figures without detailed features. The artwork uses loose, expressive lines and shaded tones to convey the serious atmosphere and interactions in courtrooms.

artworks.title: L'avocat pourchassé (The Lawyer Pursued)
artworks.medium: lithograph on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of abstract human figures in motion. The drawing is created with expressive and dynamic lines, focusing on capturing the movement and energy of the scene rather than realistic detail. Dark, bold strokes form the central figure, which appears to be turning or bending, surrounded by less defined shapes that suggest additional figures or a busy environment. The use of shading and cross-hatching adds depth, while the overall looseness of line conveys a sense of hurried activity or chaos. The composition guides the viewer’s eye across the page, creating a feeling of bustling motion and interaction among the figures.

artworks.title: Suspension d'audience (Recess of the Hearing)
artworks.medium: lithograph on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a group of figures. A seated woman holds a child, with her body visible from the torso up. She has long hair, a bowed head, and soft, undefined facial features. The woman wears a long dress, and the child is wrapped in fabric. Other figures surround them closely, with less defined features and attire. The background consists of dense, dark strokes, creating a textured backdrop.

artworks.title: a) Waiter and Customer (recto); b) Sketch of a Man and Woman (verso)
artworks.medium:
a) brush and black ink and graphite on wove paper
b) brush and black ink on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows an illustration of two individuals. One person is seated, while the other is standing and slightly bent forward. The seated person has a large mustache and wild hair, and is leaning back with an arm resting on a surface. He is wearing loose clothing. The standing person is bald, with defined facial features, wearing a long coat, and has his hands positioned in front of him. The background is minimally detailed, hinting at objects like bottles on a table.

artworks.title: a) Chimney Corner (recto); b) Two Figures (verso)
artworks.medium:
a) pen and brown ink and brown wash on wove Chapron Coquelin paper
b) pen and brown ink on wove Chapron Coquelin paper
artworks.description: The image depicts two individuals, shown in a sketch style, covering roughly their upper and mid bodies. They are seated and positioned closely together, both appearing to lean slightly forward. The figure on the left has long hair and they appear to be looking downwards. The person on the right has long hair and their face turned slightly towards the viewer. Both individuals are cloaked in loosely fitting garments. There is an arm extending from each individual, with ambiguous strokes suggesting they may be interacting with something in front of them, though no distinct object is depicted. In the background, there is minimal detail, accentuating the line work of the figures against a plain, neutral backdrop.

artworks.title: On sonne! Si c'est l'Anglais d'hier maman tu t'en iras!
artworks.medium: graphite and black crayon on wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a line drawing of two women in an interior setting. The younger woman, in a back view, is entering through a partially open door, revealing her bare back and side. Her head is turned looking back. The older woman, facing the younger one, is fully dressed and holding a garment or cloth. In the bottom left, there is a bowl, a bar of soap, and a cloth on the floor. The interior appears to be simply sketched, with visible floorboards.

artworks.title: a) Nurse and Child (recto); b) Man on Horseback (verso)
artworks.medium:
a) pen and black ink on wove paper
b) pen and black ink and purple pencil on wove paper
artworks.description: The sketch depicts two figures and a cat. The first figure is an adult supporting a standing child. The child is reaching out towards a small cat, which is standing with its back arched. The adult and child lack detailed facial features or hairstyles. Both figures are shown from the head down to the knees, without visible accessories. The background is plain, emphasizing the interaction between the figures and the cat.

artworks.title: Benediction a Lourdes
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink, brown wash, and graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures engaged in a gesture of offering or communication. The drawing features two figures sketched with loose lines; one is kneeling on the ground, extending hands towards a standing figure who is holding an object. The figures are rendered with minimal detail, using strokes that suggest movement or interaction. Background elements are lightly sketched. Shadows and folds in the garments are indicated with darker shades of the pencil.

artworks.title: Comedie Parisienne
artworks.medium: graphite and brush and black ink on wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts two people in a conversation in an indoor setting. The woman is leaning forward and pointing a finger, while the man is bending slightly towards her. The woman has an updo hairstyle and wears a long dress, while the man has a beard and mustache, balding with hair on the sides of his head. He wears a suit with plaid trousers and holds a top hat. The background shows outlined furniture and possibly framed pictures or mirrors on the walls. The style and strokes suggest a lively interaction between the two figures.

artworks.title: a) Print Connoisseur (recto); b) Sketch of Print Connoisseur (verso)
artworks.medium:
a) brush and brown ink and black chalk with brown wash and white heightening on laid Van Gelder paper
b) black crayon on laid Van Gelder paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a person kneeling on the floor facing a sketchbook or canvas on an easel. The individual has short hair and wears a loose, long-sleeved shirt with dark pants. Art supplies are scattered nearby. A table to the right holds a teapot and cup. The background is a plain wall.

artworks.title: Children Looking over the Edge of a Crib
artworks.medium: black crayon on wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts the upper bodies of two individuals leaning over the side of a crib-like structure. They are positioned closely together, both gripping the railing with both hands while peering down. The child on the left has hair that is disheveled, while the child on the right has their hair pulled back. The clothing of both individuals seems loose and relaxed, suggested by the flowing lines drawn around them. The foreground contains sketchy lines, possibly depicting a blanket or the drape of the crib. The background is minimal, with just a few faint lines, keeping focus on the two figures.

artworks.title: Le cafe concert des reservistes
artworks.medium: watercolor on wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman standing next to several men in military-style uniforms at a table. The woman has dark hair styled with bangs and an updo, pale complexion with rosy cheeks and red lips. She wears a black off-the-shoulder dress with white detailing and black gloves. One man near her carries a tray with drinks. The background consists of abstract brushstrokes in shades of blue and green, creating an impressionistic feel.

artworks.title: Peur de Bourreau! Qu'est-ce que tu attends?...
artworks.medium: black crayon on wove paper
artworks.description: The image is a horizontal sketch showing two individuals in a bedroom. One person is lying on the floor, visible from the side with short hair and resting on elbows. The other person is sitting on their knees, holding a stick, also seen from the side with a round face and short hair. Both wear loose clothing. In the background, a bed with a blanket covering an indistinct figure is partially visible along with clothes or fabric under the bed. The sketch is in black and white with emphasis on outlines and shades. The background is bare, and there is text at the top and bottom of the image.

artworks.title: a) Lady and Gentleman in Evening Dress (recto); b) Sketch of Figure (verso)
artworks.medium:
a) pen and black ink on wove paper
b) pen and black ink on wove paper
artworks.description: The image features a pencil drawing of two people, with only the upper body and heads visible. One person is seen in profile from the side, standing with their back slightly turned towards the viewer. This person has delicate facial features, with noticeable emphasis on the eye and nose, and their hair is styled in an ornate updo. Their clothing is suggested with a low neckline and an earring adorns the ear. The second person is depicted facing forward, with a mustache and square jawline. Little detail is provided for their attire. The background of the image is mostly bare, with dark shading behind the first person's head.

artworks.title: Farniente
artworks.medium: watercolor on wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a watercolor painting of a person from the shoulders up, with a casual approach to defining body parts. The person faces slightly to the side, with a red mouth, softly painted eyes, and a gentle expression. The loose hair flows in light brown tones blending into a plain beige background. Additional details or clothing are not clearly defined, keeping the focus on the upper body and face.

artworks.title: Nude on Rocks
artworks.medium: watercolor on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a painting of a nude figure lying on rocks by a shoreline. The composition focuses on a reclining form draped over a smooth surface, surrounded by large, rugged boulders in a natural setting. The color palette is limited to sepia tones, contributing to a monochromatic aesthetic that enhances the texture and form of the rocks. There is a sense of tranquility and harmony within the natural environment, conveyed through the gentle brushstrokes and soft transitions between shadows and highlights.

artworks.title: a) Chauffeur and Procession (recto); b) Two Sketches of Chauffeur and Passenger (verso)
artworks.medium:
a) black crayon on wove paper
b) graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures sitting side by side, looking towards a distant structure resembling a church. The drawing is executed in sketchy pencil strokes, creating an impressionistic and gestural depiction. The figures are outlined in simple, flowing lines, with minimal detail. The distant structure features a cross on its roof and is surrounded by faint indications of trees or buildings on a flat landscape. The overall composition of the drawing directs the viewer's eye from the foreground figures to the background structure.

artworks.title: Marshal Petain
artworks.medium: watercolor and pen and black ink on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a person from the waist up. The person is standing upright, looking slightly to their left with a confident posture. They have a distinct facial profile with a noticeable mustache and a bald head. The person is wearing a light-colored buttoned tunic that resembles a uniform. The surroundings depict a barren landscape with sandy or desert-like terrain. To the left, there is another figure, less defined and possibly seated. The background features a dark, swirling cloud-filled sky contrasting with the sandy ground.

artworks.title: a) Ludus pro Populo (recto); b) Head of a Man (verso)
artworks.medium:
a) black crayon on wove paper
b) black crayon on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows three full-body figures in a monochromatic style. On the left, a standing woman looks downward towards a seated man in the center, who is hunched over. Beside him is a child, looking at the man's hands which hold an object resembling a plate. The figures are dressed in long, simple garments. The background suggests a sparse room with a possible table. French text is included above and below the figures.
